_readme: THIS FILE IS THE WHOLE SALE. Edit it to swap the weekly campaign — sales.html reads it and rebuilds itself. Rules: never write a date (use 'while supplies last'), never invent a price. Every text field takes { en, es } and both are required. A product 'image' is a path WITHOUT the file extension — ship a ~640x640 .webp AND a .jpg at that path (full-resolution originals live one folder up, in products/).
